description: A beginner friendly, virtual team working on 'abandoned but not forgotten' storytelling challenge. Goal is to create a fun project (i.e a digital storybook or a simple interactive website) that tells the story of NASA's old rovers and equipment left on moon and mars.
summary: "The secret diaries of Space robots" is an educational digital comic book designed for school-aged children. It tells the story of NASA's abandoned robots from the perspective of the machines themselves. The comic teaches kids about planetary geology, atmospheric flight and space itself. It fulfills the "Abandoned but not forgotten" challenge by proving even when hardware has stopped working, its legacy still continues to teach us about the universe.
details: Our project is a 3 page digital comic book created using Canva. We used storytelling and graphic design to make the complex science easier to understand for children. We researched the specific geological and atmospheric data collected by the Opportunity Rover, the Ingenuity Helicopter, the Lunar Roving Vehicle and Voyager 1. The comic is entirely free to access and designed as a learning tool for classrooms.
